RESTRICTED SHARE AWARD SCHEME                                               限制性股份獎勵計劃

On 22 March 2010 (the “Adoption Date”), the Board adopted                   於二零一零年三月二十二日（「採納日期」），董
the Restricted Share Award Scheme. Pursuant to the Restricted               事會採納限制性股份獎勵計劃。根據限制性股
Share Award Scheme, the Directors, employees, officers, agents              份獎勵計劃，本公司及其附屬公司之董事、僱
and consultants of the Company and its subsidiaries are entitled to         員、高級職員、代理及顧問均有權參與是項計
participate in this scheme.                                                 劃。


The purposes of the Restricted Share Award Scheme are to assist the         限制性股份獎勵計劃之目的為協助本公司吸納
Company in attracting new staff as well as motivating and retaining its     新人、激勵及挽留現有人才。
existing talents.


The Restricted Share Award Scheme shall be effective from the               限制性股份獎勵計劃由採納日期起生效，並持
Adoption Date and shall continue in effect for a term of 10 years and       續生效十年，由其管理委員會及本公司限制性
be managed by the Administration Committee and the trustee of the           股份獎勵計劃信託的受託人（「受託人」）管理。
Restricted Share Award Scheme trust of the Company (the “Trustee”).         於二零二零年三月十六日，董事會決議將限制
On 16 March 2020, the Board resolved to extend the period of the            性股份獎勵計劃的期限延長十年。因此，本應
Restricted Share Award Scheme for another ten years. As a result,           於二零二零年三月二十一日終止的限制性股份
the Restricted Share Awards Scheme, which should have originally            獎勵計劃將於二零三零年三月二十一日終止，
terminated on 21 March 2020, shall, unless terminated earlier by a          除非經董事會決議案提前終止。限制性股份獎
resolution of the Board, terminate on 21 March 2030. The remaining          勵計劃的剩餘期限約為5年。
life of the Restricted Share Award Scheme was approximately 5 years.

     Provisions                                                                撥備


     Provisions are recognised when the Group has a present                    當由於過往事件導致本集團現時須承

     of the obligation.

     the consideration required to settle the present obligation at            現時責任所需代價的最佳估計，並已
     the end of the reporting period, taking into account the risks            考慮有關責任的風險及不確定性。當
     and uncertainties surrounding the obligation. When a provision            使用為履行現時責任而估計的現金流
     is measured using the cash flows estimated to settle the                  量計量撥備時，其賬面值為該等現金
     present obligation, its carrying amount is the present value of           流量的現值（倘貨幣時間價值的影響重
     those cash flows (when the effect of the time value of money              大）。
     is material).

35. CAPITAL RISK MANAGEMENT                                                   35. 資本風險管理
   The Group manages its capital to ensure that entities in the Group          本集團管理其資本，以確保本集團轄下實
   will be able to continue as a going concern while maximising the            體能夠持續經營，同時通過優化債務及權
   return to shareholders through the optimisation of the debt and             益結構，實現股東回報最大化。本集團的
   equity balance. The Group’s overall strategy remains unchanged              整體策略與去年相同。
   from prior year.


   The capital structure of the Group consists of net debt, which              本集團的資本架構由負債淨額（包括分別
   includes the bank borrowings, lease liabilities and bonds payable           於附註30、31及33中披露的銀行借貸、租
   disclosed in Notes 30, 31 and 33 respectively, net of cash and              賃負債及應付債券（扣除現金及現金等值項
   cash equivalents and equity of the Group, comprising issued share           目））及本集團權益（包括已發行股本、保
   capital, retained profits, other reserves and NCI.                          留盈利、其他儲備及非控股權益）組成。


   The directors of the Company review the capital structure on a              本公司董事每半年檢討一次資本架構。作
   semi-annual basis. As part of this review, the directors of the             為檢討的一部分，本公司董事考慮資本成
   Company consider the cost of capital and the risks associated               本及各類資本相關風險。根據本公司董事
   with each class of capital. Based on recommendations of the                 的建議，本集團將透過支付股息、發行新
   directors of the Company, the Group will balance its overall capital        股及股份回購以及發行新債或償還現有債
   structure through the payment of dividends, new share issues                務來平衡其整體資本架構。
   and share buy-backs as well as the issue of new debts or the
   repayment of existing debts.
